pr_title: perf: add toJSON to performance class
pr_body:
Added toJSON method to the InternalPerformance class as per the
convention followed in other performance classes and per the spec:
https://www.w3.org/TR/hr-time/#tojson-method

Fixes: #37623

issue_context.title: Performance should have a toJSON method
issue_context.body:
Reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/hr-time/#tojson-method

There are WPT for it but they are currently written in HTML: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/79fa4cf76e0d39e3fc1b7ead85e067b0a064b892/hr-time/performance-tojson.html
comments: Is it still in discussion phase or can it be implemented in the source?
I think it can be implemented.
Cool, let me kickstart the work on this. If no one has already started yet.

review_comments:
I'm not sure we should include `eventLoopUtilisation` (because it's a method on `performance`, not an object property).
@jasnell wdyt?
I just thought that it would be much more usable if a user consumes this API. Let's wait for @jasnell thoughts.
Sorry, just now spotted the mention. I'm fine with it either way.
